# Changelog

All notable changes are recorded here. Versions follow Semantic Versioning while the package remains below 1.0.

## 0.6.0 — 2026-09-07

- Added the complete 38-slot launcher panel and configurable panel hotkey.
- Added streamlined binding for applications, files, folders, and HTTP(S) websites.
- Added optional direct global shortcuts, conflict alternatives, panel-only fallback, and revision-aware undo.
- Added Finder/browser drag and drop with replacement confirmation.
- Added real favicon discovery with strict network/privacy limits, deterministic fallbacks, cache controls, and custom website icons.
- Added host-owned theme, UI preferences, application catalog, website icon provider, event, diagnostics, storage, and lifecycle boundaries.
- Added responsive layout, keyboard navigation, accessibility behavior, appearance support, and non-border selection indicator.
- Added a visible in-panel editor for the panel summon shortcut.
- Added public-host compile verification and migration-ready source packaging.
- Prepared the public source release under GPL-3.0 with Copyright (C) 2026 miseon-stack, the `io.github.miseon-stack.shortcutlauncher` namespace, and GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting.
